svg.aria-label: The rsc company brain: anything dropped into inbox is ingested into a wiki that is both an OKF bundle and an Obsidian vault, with raw sources and the agent's own worklog kept underneath
svg.title: rsc-harness — the company brain
svg.desc: A three-dimensional knowledge graph. Loose material drifts in from the left: the inbox, where any file in any format is dropped. It is absorbed into the bright green cluster, the wiki — an Obsidian-native vault whose brightest hubs are its .base views: Decisions, Specs, Standards, Verifications, Worklog. The dim clusters behind are raw sources and the agent's own captured worklog, present but out of the way. The amber cluster is what the wiki knows it is missing: gaps.
svg.text: Chaos goes in. Knowledge comes out. Nothing is deleted on the way.
Drop any file, any format. It is copied, never moved away.
An OKF bundle and an Obsidian vault at the same time.
brightest hubs = .base views · Decisions · Specs · Standards · Verifications
Sources, and the agent's own work,
What the brain knows it does not know.
inbox/ plus an automatic sweep of the workspace,
filenames. Opens as a plain Obsidian vault.
Every skill reads it before acting, so the next
session starts where the last one stopped.
